objective: distinguish authentic MCL phase-front pivots from frequent CL-only oscillations before any new economic replay

dual_book_identity.cl: unchanged Stage112 directional-impulse parameters on completed matched CL 5m bars
dual_book_identity.mcl: the same directional-impulse parameters independently applied to completed matched MCL 5m bars
dual_book_identity.minimum_law: entry breadth is the minimum CL/MCL breadth; one book can never stand in for the other
dual_book_identity.warmup: partial horizon arrays and cross-contract comparisons are unavailable, never neutral or inferred

origin_law.major_shock: unchanged Stage119 fixed dual-book flush-reversal morphology; every fresh major origin resets stale untraded state
origin_law.ordinary: both books have the same fully aligned incumbent five-slope stack and both 30m velocities jointly flip opposite it; at least one book was not aligned on the prior completed 5m state
origin_law.direction: joint price-path and velocity state only; volume supplies regime seriousness but no directional vote

ownership_law.pre_cross: both books must retain new-direction 30m velocity until both 30m slopes cross
ownership_law.failure: loss by either book before both crosses terminates the untraded epoch immediately
ownership_law.arrival_order: first velocity and slope arrivals within each book must be nondecreasing from 30m toward 480m; equal-time ties are lawful
ownership_law.extreme_retention: major origins must preserve both CL and MCL reversal extremes through admission
ownership_law.recoil: post-cross loss of either fast slope before velocity reacquisition releases authority
ownership_law.position_arbitration: flat may open; same-direction Stage112 only attaches; opposite Stage112 cannot be interrupted without authentic seconds Stage114 authority

zero_cross_eta.definition: for an opposite slope with new-direction velocity, eta is abs(slope divided by velocity); an already crossed slope is zero; unresolved or wrong-direction velocity is unavailable
zero_cross_eta.joint_scalar: median of finite CL and MCL eta values across the five horizons
zero_cross_eta.contraction: the joint scalar must decline from the immediately preceding completed state into the candidate state
zero_cross_eta.role: declared categorical neighbor, not an outcome-fitted coefficient

count_gate.cadence_capacity: at least one connected strict family must retain enough non-overlapping events to permit more than 200 Stage112-composed trades per year

known_incident.required: the authentic 2026-08-06 Stage114 UP wave resets the stale 03:50 front and reaches joint tradeable propagation by 05:45 at the latest
known_incident.negative_control: the 01:25 impulse cannot borrow authority from the later wave
known_incident.historical_role: excluded from count selection and outcomes
